### Description

Replenish and revive your skin with the Deep Vita C Capsule Cream by Medicube. Packed with encapsulated Vitamin C, this nourishing cream bursts on contact to release brightening and antioxidant benefits, leaving skin smooth, radiant, and healthy-looking.

**Key Features**

- Encapsulated Vitamin C for maximum freshness.
- Improves uneven skin tone.
- Nourishes and protects the skin barrier.

### How to Use

Apply evenly to face and neck after serum, gently massaging until absorbed. Use morning and night.



### What's in it

Hippophae Rhamnoides Water, Butylene Glycol, 1,2-Hexanediol, Glycerin, Water, Niacinamide, Methylpropanediol, Propanediol, Dipropylene Glycol, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Glycereth-26, Ethylhexyl Palmitate, Cetearyl Alcohol, Arginine, Cetearyl Olivate, Sorbitan Olivate, Ammonium Acryloyldimethyltaurate/Vp Copolymer, Helianthus Annuus Seed Oil, Glycine Soja Oil, Bixa Orellana Seed Oil, Tocopherol, Polyglyceryl-10 Laurate, Simethicone, Carbomer, Ethylhexylglycerin, Hydrogenated Lecithin, Polyglyceryl-10 Stearate, Panthenol, Sodium Ascorbyl Phosphate, Folic Acid, Pyridoxine, Biotin, Cyanocobalamin, Thiamine Hcl, Beta-Carotene, Riboflavin, Linoleic Acid, Polyacrylate-13, Polyisobutene, Polysorbate 20, Sorbitan Isostearate, Adenosine, Fragrance, Disodium Edta, Glyceryl Stearate, Hydrolyzed Sclerotium Gum, Gluconolactone, Sodium Hyaluronate, Ascorbyl Propyl Hyaluronate, Alpha-Arbutin, Pentylene Glycol, Hydroxyphenyl Propamidobenzoic Acid, Ascorbyl Palmitate, Ubiquinone, Ferulic Acid, 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid, Ascorbyl Glucoside, Rutin, Hydroxycinnamic Acid, Bisabolol, Ascorbic Acid

### Additional Information

55g

### How do I apply the Deep Vita C Capsule Cream for best results?

Apply a small amount to clean, dry skin as the final step in your evening routine. Gently massage until the capsules burst and the cream is fully absorbed. Always follow with SPF during the day as vitamin C can increase photosensitivity.

### Is this cream suitable for sensitive skin types?

Yes, the encapsulated delivery system makes this cream gentler than traditional vitamin C products. The capsules protect the vitamin C from oxidation and release it gradually, reducing the risk of irritation. Start with every other night if you have very sensitive skin.

### How long before I see brightening results?

Most users notice improved skin radiance within 1-2 weeks of consistent use. For significant brightening of dark spots and overall tone improvement, continue use for 4-6 weeks. The encapsulated formula ensures fresh vitamin C delivery for optimal results.

### Description

Boost hydration and radiance with PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Capsule 100 Serum, an emerald-toned, lightweight formula enriched with PDRN, hyaluronic acid, and collagen. It supports moisture retention, smooths skin, and enhances natural glow, delivering long-lasting hydration for a refreshed, luminous complexion.

**Key Features**

- Delivers long-lasting hydration.
- Enhances natural glow and radiance.
- Supports moisture retention and smooths skin.

### How to Use

Apply a few drops to affected areas and gently pat in with your fingertips. Use morning and night before applying oils or moisturizers. When used during the day, be sure to use with SPF 30 or higher.

### What's in it

Water, Butylene Glycol, Propanediol, Glycerin, Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid, 1,2-Hexanediol, Niacinamide, Glyceryl Oleate, Lauryl Glucoside, Myristyl Glucoside, Polyglyceryl-6 Laurate, Hydrogenated Lecithin, Glutathione, Hydrolyzed Collagen, Sodium Hyaluronate, Coptis Japonica Root Extract, Adenosine, Melia Azadirachta Leaf Extract, Melia Azadirachta Flower Extract, Coccinia Indica Fruit Extract, Sodium DNA, Solanum Melongena (Eggplant) Fruit Extract, Hyaluronic Acid, Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate, Hydroxypropyltrimonium Hyaluronate, Potassium Hyaluronate, Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer, Sodium Acetylated Hyaluronate, Ocimum Sanctum Leaf Extract, Citric Acid, Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract, Corallina Officinalis Extract, Sodium Citrate, Pentylene Glycol.

### Additional Information

30ml

### How do I apply the PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Capsule Serum?

Apply 2-3 drops to clean, dry skin and gently pat into face and neck using upward motions. Follow with your regular moisturizer and always use sunscreen during the day. Use morning and evening for best results.

### Is this serum suitable for sensitive or acne-prone skin?

Yes, this lightweight, emerald-toned formula is gentle enough for sensitive skin types and won't clog pores. The hydrating ingredients help balance oil production while soothing irritation, making it suitable for most skin concerns.

### When will I see visible results from using this serum?

Most users notice improved hydration and a natural glow within 1-2 weeks of consistent use. For optimal results including smoother texture and enhanced radiance, continue using for 4-6 weeks as part of your daily skincare routine.

## Description

Hydrate and soothe your skin with the Wild Rose Shower Gel, enriched with shea butter, aloe vera, and coconut oil for deep moisture and gentle care. Its creamy formula leaves skin soft, smooth, and refreshed, while a subtle rose fragrance lingers, wrapping your body in a delicate, uplifting scent.

Key Features

Creamy formula gently cleanses and soothes skin.

Enriched with shea butter, aloe vera, and coconut oil for hydration.

## How to Use

Apply on your hands or loofah, bring to a lather and wash all over. Rinse with warm water.

## What's in it

Shea butter, Aloe vera, Coconut oil, PQ10.

## Additional Information

750ml

## How do I use Wild Rose Shower Gel?

To use Wild Rose Shower Gel, massage a generous amount onto your skin in the shower, then rinse thoroughly. For best results, use 2-3 times a week.

## Is Wild Rose Shower Gel suitable for sensitive skin?

Wild Rose Shower Gel is suitable for most skin types, including sensitive skin. However, if you have extremely sensitive skin, we recommend doing a patch test before using the product.

## What results can I expect from using Wild Rose Shower Gel?

After using Wild Rose Shower Gel, you can expect to see softer, smoother skin that feels refreshed and rejuvenated. Regular use can help to improve skin elasticity and reduce dryness. Payment Options Payment methods

## Description

Let your skin glow with a burst of hydration with the Sugar Rush Body Lotion. This rich yet fast-absorbing lotion is infused with shea butter, coconut, jojoba, and argan oils to deeply moisturize without greasiness. It softens and smooths your skin, leaving it healthy, radiant, and beautifully scented with a sweet, candy-like aroma that lasts up to 24 hours.

Key Features

Deeply hydrates without greasiness.

Infused with shea butter and natural oils.

Leaves your skin soft with a sweet, candy-like scent.

## How to Use

Apply generously to clean, dry skin. Massage gently in circular motions until fully absorbed. For best results, use daily, especially after showering or whenever your skin needs extra moisture.

## What's in it

Coconut Oil, BeesWax, Glycerin.

## Additional Information

200g

## How do I apply the Sugar Rush Body Lotion?

Apply a generous amount to your skin after showering or bathing, massaging it in thoroughly until fully absorbed.

## Who is this product suitable for?

This product is suitable for all skin types, including dry, normal, and combination skin. If you have sensitive skin, we recommend doing a patch test before using.

## What kind of results can I expect from using this product?

You can expect to see soft, smooth, and hydrated skin within a few uses. For best results, use this product consistently for a few days. Payment Options Payment methods

Its lightweight formula absorbs quickly into the skin, leaving no greasy residue while providing essential moisture. Enriched with aloe, grapefruit, apple, tomato, collagen, and allantoin, it helps restore the skin's water balance, softens, and improves elasticity for a healthier, more resilient complexion.


**Key Features**

- Restores water balance and improves elasticity.
- Provides maximum UV protection without leaving a greasy residue.

### How to Use

Apply an appropriate amount to the cheeks, nose, chin, and forehead. Evenly distribute from the center to the edges.

### What's in it

Aqua, Isopropyl Myristate, Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate, Glycerin, Ethylhexyl Salicylate, Titanium Dioxide, Isoamyl p-Methoxycinnamate, Diethylamino Hydroxybenzoyl Hexyl Benzoate, Sorbitan Sesquioleate, Cetyl PEGPPG-10 1 Dimethicone, Zinc oxide, Sodium Chloride, Ethylhexyl Triazone, Microcrystalline Wax, Beeswax, Butylene Glycol, Аloebarbadensis leaf extract, Morus Alba Bark Extract, Olea Europaea (Olive) Fruit Extract, Citrus Paradisi (Grapefruit) Fruit Extract, Citrus Aurantium Dulcis (Orange) Fruit Extract, Solanum Licopersicum (Tomato) Fruit Extract, Phenoxyethanol, ci19140 – Color Index 19140, CI15985, Parfum.

### Additional Information

70ml

### How often should I apply the Oil-Free UV Defence Sun Cream?

Apply the Oil-Free UV Defence Sun Cream every morning after cleansing and moisturizing. For optimal protection, reapply every 2 hours or immediately after swimming or sweating.

### Is this product suitable for sensitive skin types?

Yes, the Oil-Free UV Defence Sun Cream is suitable for sensitive skin types. However, if you experience any discomfort, discontinue use and consult a dermatologist.

### Can I use it under my makeup?

Yes, you can use the Oil-Free UV Defence Sun Cream under your makeup. It provides a smooth, even base for makeup application and won't clog pores.

## Description

Brighten and hydrate the delicate eye area with Nawah’s Eye Cream. The cushiony formula smooths the look of fine lines and provides lasting moisture for a rested, radiant appearance.

Key Features

Targets dryness and the look of fine lines.

Lightweight texture that layers under makeup.

Leaves the eye area soft, supple, and luminous.

## How to Use

Dot a small amount under the eyes and gently pat with your ring finger until absorbed. Use morning and evening.

## Additional Information

50ml

## How do I apply the eye cream?

Gently pat a small amount under your eyes, starting from the inner corner and moving outward. This will help the product absorb evenly and reduce the appearance of fine lines.

## Is this product suitable for sensitive skin?

Yes, our eye cream is formulated with gentle, non-irritating ingredients that are suitable for sensitive skin. If you have any concerns, we recommend doing a patch test before using the product.

## Will the eye cream reduce puffiness and dark circles?

While our eye cream is designed to address dryness and fine lines, it may not completely eliminate puffiness and dark circles. However, it can help to reduce their appearance by hydrating and brightening the under-eye area. Payment Options Payment methods

## Description

Brighten and hydrate the delicate skin around your eyes with the Bright & Glow Eye Cream. Specially designed to reduce puffiness, dark circles, fine lines, and wrinkles, it delivers noticeable results in just 4 weeks of consistent use. Hydrating and soothing, it helps create a smooth, youthful, and radiant eye contour for a refreshed look.

Key Features

Reduces puffiness, dark circles, and fine lines.

Noticeable results in 4 weeks of consistent use.

Hydrates and soothes for a youthful, refreshed appearance.

## How to Use

Apply gently to the eye contour area using the roller ball, then massage until fully absorbed. Use twice daily.

## What's in it

Caffeine, green tea, hyaluronic acid, mica, vitamin c.

# Clean Shot Enzymatic Peeling

Brand: Eveline

Type: Face Scrub

Regular price EGP 350.00 Sale price EGP 350.00 Regular price EGP 0.00 Unit price / per Sold out or 4 interest-free payments of EGP 87.50

## Description

Refresh and smooth your skin with Clean Shot Enzymatic Peeling, a gentle exfoliating treatment designed for all skin types, including sensitive skin. Powered by Pumpkin Enzymes, Papain, Bromelain, and Ficin, it helps remove dead skin cells without harsh scrubbing while supporting skin renewal. Regular use helps improve skin texture, refine the appearance of pores, and reveal a softer, brighter, and more radiant complexion.

Key Features

Gentle enzyme blend exfoliates without scrubbing.

Helps refine pores and improve texture.

Reveals softer brighter-looking skin.

## How to Use

Apply an even layer to clean skin, avoiding the eye area, leave on for 5 minutes, then gently massage with damp hands and rinse thoroughly. Use 1–2 times weekly.

## What's in it

Aqua, Glycerin, Carbomer, Triethanolamine, Bromelain, Ficin, Papain, Lactobacillus/Pumpkin Fruit Ferment Filtrate, Leuconostoc/Radish Root Ferment Filtrate, Glucose, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Hydroxyacetophenone, Parfum, Polyacrylamide, C13-14 Isoalkane, Laureth-7, Tetrasodium Glutamate Diacetate, Benzyl Salicylate, Linalool.

## Description

Cleanse your skin gently and effectively with Clean Shot Ultra-soft Face Cleansing Foam. Formulated with Niacinamide, Panthenol, Betaine, and Glycerin, this ultra-soft foam removes makeup, impurities, and excess oil without disrupting the skin’s natural moisture barrier. The hydrating formula leaves the complexion feeling fresh, comfortable, and perfectly clean while helping to soothe and maintain healthy-looking skin.

Key Features

Gently removes makeup and impurities.

Helps maintain the skin moisture barrier.

Leaves skin fresh clean and comfortable.

## How to Use

Apply a small amount to damp skin and massage gently in circular motions, then rinse thoroughly with water before continuing with your skincare routine.

## What's in it

Aqua (Water), Glycerin, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Coco-Glucoside, Heptyl Glucoside, Sodium Cocoyl Glutamate, Panthenol, Niacinamide, Betaine, Parfum (Fragrance), Citric Acid, Sodium Chloride, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate, Hexamethylindanopyran, Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes.

## Description

Illuminate your skin with Ninetimes' Vitamin C Serum, packed with antioxidants to brighten and protect. This potent formula helps to reduce dark spots and improve skin texture, promoting a more radiant complexion. Ideal for daily use, it revitalizes tired skin for a youthful glow.

Key Features

Reduces dark spots.

Improves skin texture.

Promotes a radiant complexion.

## How to Use

Apply a pea size from serum after face cleansing, it can be applied in the morning before using sunscreen.

## What's in it

Vitamin c 15%, brightenyl, lumiskin glycerin, whitening complex 9.

## Additional Information

30ml

## What makes this serum different from other vitamin C serums?

Our Vitamin C Serum is formulated with a high concentration of ascorbic acid, which is clinically proven to brighten and even out skin tone. This sets it apart from other vitamin C serums on the market.

## How often should I use this serum for optimal results?

We recommend using this serum once or twice a day, depending on your skin type and concerns. Start with a small amount and gradually increase as your skin becomes more tolerant.

## Will this serum work for sensitive skin?

Yes, our Vitamin C Serum is suitable for sensitive skin. We've carefully selected ingredients that are gentle and non-irritating, making it perfect for those with sensitive skin. Payment Options Payment methods

Illuminate your skin with Bright & Glow Face Serum, formulated to deliver instant radiance while evening out your skin tone. This advanced serum deeply hydrates, smooths texture, and minimizes the appearance of fine lines for a flawless, youthful complexion.

**Key Features**

- Delivers instant radiance and evens skin tone.
- Deeply hydrates and smooths skin texture.
- Minimizes the appearance of fine lines.

### How to Use

Apply a few drops to your face and neck morning and night. Gently massage until fully absorbed, then follow with face cream.

### What's in it

Hyaluronic acid, mica, niacinamide.

### Additional Information

30ml

### Is this product suitable for sensitive skin?

Our Bright & Glow Face Serum is formulated with gentle, non-irritating ingredients that won't exacerbate sensitive skin. However, as with any new skincare product, we recommend doing a patch test before incorporating it into your routine.

### How long will it take to see results from using this serum?

You can start to see results within 2-4 weeks of consistent use, although individual results may vary. For optimal results, use the serum morning and night, applying a few drops to your face and neck.

### Can I use this product under my makeup?

Yes, you can use this product under your makeup. In fact, it's a great primer, helping your makeup stay in place for longer and giving you a smooth, even base.

## Description

Reveal a brighter, more even complexion with Bright & Glow Day Cream, enriched with SPF 30 to hydrate, smooth, and protect your skin. It helps reduce wrinkles and fine lines while delivering long-lasting moisture for a radiant glow.

Key Features

Enriched with SPF 30 for sun protection.

Hydrates and smooths skin.

Reduces wrinkles and fine lines.

Provides long-lasting moisture.

## How to Use

Apply in the morning to clean skin. Take a small amount in your palm or apply directly to the face and neck. Gently massage using your fingertips until fully absorbed.

## What's in it

Hyaluronic acid, alpha arbutin, niacinamide.

## Additional Information

60ml

## How do I apply the Bright & Glow Day Cream?

Apply a small amount to your face and neck in the morning, after your regular skincare routine. Massage gently until fully absorbed.

## Who is this product suitable for?

This product is suitable for most skin types, including dry, normal, and combination skin. If you have sensitive skin, patch test before use.

## Description

Refresh and rebalance your skin with Ceramide Gel Cleanser. This pH-balanced formula gently removes excess oil, impurities, and daily buildup while helping strengthen your skin barrier. Key Features

## How to Use

DS-Ceramix, Salicylic Acid, Lactic Acid, Niacinamide, Licorice Extract.

## Description

## Description

Give your skin a refreshing boost with JUST Retinol Toner. This formula harnesses the power of retinol to smooth fine lines, improve texture, and even out skin tone. It's perfect for revitalizing your complexion and preparing your skin for the next steps in your skincare routine.

Key Features:

Smooths fine lines and improves skin texture.

Evens out skin tone and revitalizes complexion.

## How to Use

Apply in the morning and/or evening with a cotton pad to clean and completely dry skin, avoiding the eye area. No need to rinse off.

## What's in it

Water (Aqua), Propylene Glycol, PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Polysorbate 20, Jasmine Flower Extract (Jasminum Officinale Flower Extract), Glycerin, Sodium Hyaluronate, Provitamin B5 (Panthenol), PPG-1-PEG-9 Lauryl Glycol Ether, Phenoxyethanol, Vitamin A Palmitate (Retinyl Palmitate), Disodium EDTA, Rosemary Oil (Rosmarinus Officinalis Leaf Oil), Citric Acid, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate.

## Description

Cleanse and refresh with Buzz Honey & Lemon Face Cleansing Gel. This gentle yet effective formula removes impurities while nourishing the skin with honey's hydration and lemon's brightening properties. It leaves your face feeling clean, fresh, and revitalized.

Key Features:

## How to Use

Apply one or two pumps of the gel to wet skin, avoiding the eye area, and gently massage to lather. Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.

## Description

Even and illuminate with Nawah’s Whitening Cream. This brightening moisturizer helps improve the look of uneven tone and dark spots while delivering daily hydration for a smoother, more radiant complexion.

Key Features

Helps visibly even skin tone and radiance.

Lightweight moisture for everyday wear.

Smooths texture for a brighter look over time.

## How to Use

Apply evenly to cleansed face and neck. Massage until fully absorbed. Use daily, morning and night.

## Additional Information

50ml

## How often should I apply the Whitening Cream?

For optimal results, apply the Whitening Cream twice a day, morning and night, after cleansing and toning. Be sure to gently massage the cream into your skin until fully absorbed.

## Can I use this cream if I have sensitive skin?

While the Whitening Cream is suitable for most skin types, we recommend patch testing it on a small area of your skin before using it on your face. If you experience any irritation, discontinue use.

## Will I see results after using this cream?

With consistent use, you can expect to see noticeable improvements in your skin tone and texture within 2-4 weeks. However, individual results may vary, and patience is key. Payment Options Payment methods

## Description

Balance and prep with Nawah’s Facial Toner. This refreshing toner sweeps away residual impurities, refines the look of pores, and primes skin to better absorb treatments and moisturizers.

Key Features

Refreshes and rebalances after cleansing.

Helps refine the look of pores.

Optimizes absorption of serums and creams.

## How to Use

After cleansing, apply toner to a cotton pad and sweep over face and neck. Follow with serum or moisturizer.

## Additional Information

200ml

## How do I use the Facial Toner?

Begin by sweeping the toner across your face and neck with a cotton pad after cleansing. Follow up with your favorite serum and moisturizer for optimal absorption. Use daily for best results.

## Is the Facial Toner suitable for sensitive skin?

The Facial Toner is gentle and non-irritating, making it suitable for most skin types, including sensitive skin. However, if you have extremely sensitive skin, we recommend doing a patch test before use.

## Can I expect to see results from using the Facial Toner?

With regular use, you can expect to see refined pores, balanced skin, and improved product absorption. Results may vary depending on individual skin concerns and types. Payment Options Payment methods

### Description

Achieve clearer, smoother skin with the AHA/BHA Clarifying Treatment Toner. This powerful formula combines AHA, BHA, and purifying botanicals to exfoliate, refine texture, and balance oil production. It clears congested pores, leaving your skin soft, hydrated, and revitalized with every use.


**Key Features**

- Exfoliates and refines texture with AHA and BHA.
- Clears pores and balances oil production.

### How to Use

After cleansing, spray the toner onto a cotton pad and gently wipe over the face, avoiding the eyes and mouth. For daytime use, follow with a broad-spectrum sunscreen (SPF 30 or greater).
 \*Avoid using with other acids (AHAs/BHAs), retinols, or Vitamin C.
 \*Avoid use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

### What's in it

Water, Salix Alba (Willow) Bark Water, Pyrus Malus (Apple) Fruit Water, Butylene Glycol, 1,2-Hexanediol, Sodium Lactate, Glycolic Acid, Betaine Salicylate, Allantoin, Panthenol, Ethyl Hexanediol.

### How often should I use this clarifying toner?

Start by using the toner 2-3 times per week in your evening routine, gradually increasing to daily use as your skin builds tolerance. Always follow with moisturizer and use SPF during the day as AHA/BHA can increase sun sensitivity.

### Is this suitable for sensitive or dry skin types?

This toner is formulated for oily, combination, and acne-prone skin types. If you have sensitive or very dry skin, start with once weekly use and monitor your skin's response, or consult with a dermatologist before incorporating into your routine.

### When will I start seeing clearer skin results?

Most users notice improved skin texture and reduced pore congestion within 1-2 weeks of consistent use. For significant improvements in breakouts and overall skin clarity, allow 4-6 weeks of regular application to see optimal results.

### Description

Revive delicate eye skin with Beauty of Joseon’s Revive Eye Serum Ginseng + Retinal. This targeted formula blends energizing ginseng with retinal to visibly reduce fine lines, boost firmness, and revive tired-looking eyes with a firmer, smoother finish.

**Key Features**

- Retinal helps reduce fine lines and improves texture around the eyes.
- Ginseng provides revitalizing, firming benefits.
- Light, fast-absorbing serum designed for the delicate eye area.

### How to Use

Using the applicator or fingertips, apply a small amount around the eye area. Gently tap to absorb. Use morning and night.

### What's in it

Water, Panax Ginseng Root Extract, Glycerin, Dipropylene Glycol, Caprylic/​Capric Triglyceride, 1,2-Hexanediol, Pentaerythrityl Tetraethylhexanoate, Niacinamide, Butyleneglycol Dicaprylate/​Dicaprate, Cetearyl Alcohol, Sorbitan Olivate, Cetearyl Olivate, Butylene Glycol, Hydrogenated Lecithin, Tromethamine, Carbomer, Glyceryl Stearate, Macadamia Ternifolia Seed Oil, Adenosine, Theobroma Cacao (Cocoa) Extract, Dextrin, Cholesterol, Polyglyceryl-10 Oleate, Retinal, Brassica Campestris (Rapeseed) Sterols, Phytosteryl/​Behenyl/​Octyldodecyl Lauroyl Glutamate, Silica, Sodium Hyaluronate, Tocopherol, Aluminum/​Magnesium Hydroxide Stearate, Potassium Cetyl Phosphate, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-Di-T-Butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Ceramide NP, Palmitoyl Tripeptide-5, Disodium EDTA, Ethylhexylglycerin


### Additional Information

### How do I apply this eye serum for best results?

Gently pat a small amount around the orbital bone using your ring finger, avoiding direct contact with the eyelid. Apply morning and evening after cleansing but before moisturizer. Always use gentle tapping motions rather than rubbing to protect the delicate eye skin.

### Is this suitable for sensitive eye area and all skin types?

Yes, this serum is specifically formulated for the sensitive eye area with gentle retinal instead of harsh retinol. It's suitable for all skin types, but if you're new to retinal products, start with every other night to allow your skin to adjust gradually.

### When will I start seeing visible improvements in my eye area?

Most users notice improved skin texture and reduced fine lines within 2-3 weeks of consistent use. For optimal firming and anti-aging benefits, continue use for 6-8 weeks as the ginseng and retinal work together to revitalize and strengthen the eye area.

### Description

Turn back the clock on aging skin with Kolagra Retinol Serum. This powerful anti-aging serum visibly smooths fine lines and wrinkles, firms sagging skin, fades dark spots, and restores a radiant, youthful glow. Formulated with a concentrated dose of retinol, Kolagra Retinol Serum renews skin cell production to diminish signs of aging. It also stimulates collagen production to plump skin and smooth wrinkles from the inside out.

**Key Features**

- Firms and lifts sagging skin.
- Brightens and evens skin tone.
- Reduces the appearance of fine lines.

### How to Use

For optimal results, apply 3-4 drops on your face and neck at night after cleansing with a gentle cleanser and before applying moisturizer. Follow up with daily SPF.

### How often should I apply the Retinol Serum?

For optimal results, apply the Retinol Serum at night, 2-3 times a week, to allow the skin to fully absorb its benefits. Start with a small amount and gradually increase as needed. Be sure to follow up with a gentle moisturizer to help lock in the serum's benefits.

### Is the Retinol Serum suitable for sensitive skin?

The Retinol Serum is generally suitable for most skin types, but it's always best to patch test a small area of skin before beginning regular use. If you experience any irritation or discomfort, discontinue use and consult a dermatologist.

### How long will it take to see results from the Retinol Serum?

Results may vary from person to person, but most users begin to see noticeable improvements in skin texture and tone within 4-6 weeks of regular use. Consistency is key, so be sure to continue using the Retinol Serum as directed for optimal results.
